acceptance_correction.concern: A tool Future could complete after an idle has_unfinished_requests() observation; the redundant second collection admitted its branch without another engine check and then raised a false trace stall.
acceptance_correction.reproduction: tests/test_contention.py::test_idle_dispatch_steps_request_admitted_by_late_tool_completion failed deterministically with RuntimeError: trace stalled without requests, tools, or arrivals.
acceptance_correction.fix: Removed the redundant second admit_due_background() and collect_finished_tools() calls. The existing event wait returns immediately for a completed Future or due arrival, and the next loop performs admission before the engine check.
acceptance_correction.regression: 1 passed after the fix; full tests/test_contention.py passed 8/8 remotely with CUDA disabled.
acceptance_correction.rerun: All 30 main traces were regenerated under the unchanged protocol, rates, seeds, prompts, method order, model, and GPU.

methodology_limits.execution_order: Counterbalanced only by capacity: 512 MiB ran APC, Octopus, native-default APC; 2 GiB ran Octopus, APC, native-default APC. It was not interleaved per seed and native-default always ran last.
methodology_limits.common_overlap_cutoff: The paired common-overlap cohort is selected by intended arrival no later than min(APC foreground end, Octopus foreground end). It is cohort-matched but outcome-dependent, not a globally fixed time window.
methodology_limits.uncertainty: Three seeds are exploratory; small differences can mix scheduler behavior with warming or time-of-run effects.

allocator_admission_boundary.evidence_type: Independent CPU-only native KVCacheManager fact, not GPU latency measurement
allocator_admission_boundary.example: B=16 usable blocks, P=8 retained blocks, R=12 unrelated background blocks: APC admission true, retained admission false, admission true after lease release
